claims.title: Compare repair stiffness under unknown tensile load, then preserve nutrient supply and maturation costs

quoted_fields.interface: Quasistatic elastic equilibrium with positive Hookean a,b,c,d, nonnegative sensing stiffness k, common fixed boundary geometry and positive tensile excitation. Multiple sensing arms use the actual coupled equilibrium, not independently assumed thresholds. Flow and precursor results require their separately declared ODEs, fixed conversion and actual useful incorporation. Observation counterexamples preserve prescribed displacement, full scaled reference/probe or the stated equal-prior two-action toy.
quoted_fields.failure: The bridge is a known elastic-comparison principle, not a new elasticity theorem or acquired repair device. Sign independence does not give load-independent signal amplitude, noise margin, zero-load sensing, absolute strength or fatigue certification. Cubic-slit asymptotics assume instantaneous response; delayed precursor dynamics are a separate model. Synthetic calibrated thresholds, 1.004–1.005 endpoints and repeated-repair fractions are producer reports, not independently replayed or measured biology. Uniform region independence and finite noise/assessment windows cannot be turned into a joint material guarantee. Ionic continuity does not acquire glucose/oxygen flux. Guided fungal growth, cellulose composites, sensors and fluidic hysterons are source-cited components, not newly primary-audited papers or an integrated interface.
